title: Unisex Anime – Sharing Is Not My Love Language Hoodie

seo.title: Funny Anime Hoodie: Sharing Is Not My Love Language
seo.description: A funny anime hoodie: a samurai cat guarding the last dumpling, SHARING IS NOT MY LOVE LANGUAGE. Printed to order, free US shipping on $45+.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny anime hoodie is for the fan who guards the last dumpling like a samurai, and wears it to takeout night, ramen runs and every watch party with a shared plate.

A stern white cat in a red samurai helmet and green sneakers raises chopsticks beside a steaming bamboo basket with one dumpling left. SHARING IS NOT runs above in heavy letters and MY LOVE LANGUAGE below.

Pull it on for dumpling night, cold walks to the ramen shop and every group order where somebody reaches for your plate. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Unisex Anime Sharing Is Not My Love Language hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Navy. On Sand the lettering is printed in navy and brick red, and on Navy it is cream and coral, so every word stays easy to read from across the table on either color.

Is it a good gift for an anime fan?
Yes. The Unisex Anime Sharing Is Not My Love Language hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. gives any anime fan a joke about guarding the last dumpling, in an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for convention lines and late watch parties. Order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Sharing Is Not My Love Language hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. Sharing Is Not My Love Language hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier fit over a long sleeve or a tee.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the printed lettering and the samurai cat looking sharp through every marathon of episodes.

Where does the print sit?
The Sharing Is Not My Love Language print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, with SHARING IS NOT over the cat and MY LOVE LANGUAGE beneath, so both lines read from across the room. The hood is double-lined with a matching drawcord.
